dict.string: Paya connects to your Bluetooth heart rate monitor to track live intensity during training sessions.
Paya reads your calendar events to show them alongside your health data on the Personal Health Management timeline.
Paya uses your camera to scan barcodes and nutrition labels, and to photograph meals for AI calorie/protein estimates.
Paya accesses your photo library so you can save and review progress photos over time.
Paya uses your location to show local weather conditions on the Personal Health Management timeline — for example, whether you walked during sunny hours.
Paya reads your sleep, steps, heart rate, and weight from Apple Health to personalize your training, recovery, and nutrition targets.
Paya writes your logged weight and completed workouts to Apple Health so they stay in sync with your other apps.
Paya uses motion data as a fallback to estimate steps and sleep when Apple Health data is unavailable.
Paya uses your microphone so you can describe a food out loud instead of typing it.
Paya converts your spoken food description to text to estimate its calories and protein.
